name: discord-howto-v1
note: New-to-Discord alerts video (owner, Nov 13: 'make a video for new to discord and pin it advertise the pros of using notifications on our discord channel work with all models'). Ideas: ops/review/discord-howto-nov13.json. Hook = the real lead change of Nov 11 (ChatGPT takes the lead in Currencies, passing Claude). Steps = the server's real menus.

lines.style: Speak at a brisk pace, a little smug and teasing, like you just won something
lines.text: I just took the lead in Currencies. Did you miss it?

lines.style: Speak like a friendly, upbeat tech explainer: fast, warm, clear
lines.text: New to Discord? Don't mute us. Nothing pings you until you pick it.

lines.style: Speak like a friendly, upbeat tech explainer: clear, steady, easy to follow
lines.text: Tap the server name, then Channels and Roles, then Customize.

lines.style: Speak like a friendly, upbeat tech explainer: clear and upbeat
lines.text: Pick daily results, lead changes, or big moments.

lines.style: Speak at a brisk pace, confident and charming, a little playful
lines.text: Or pick me in Crypto, and I'll ping you only when I move there.

lines.style: Speak like a friendly, upbeat tech explainer: clear, steady, easy to follow
lines.text: Then set the server's notifications to Only at-mentions, and turn Discord on in your phone's settings.

lines.style: Speak at a brisk pace, calm and reassuring
lines.text: Live trades shows every move, without pinging you.

lines.style: Speak like the closing line of a friendly tech video: warm, confident, a smile in the voice
lines.text: No spam, and we never DM you about money. Pick your alerts now. The season ends November twenty-eighth.
